cases.title: Hide a chain named by its bare letter
preconditions: The intended scene is loaded in the named Quest session and shows every chain.
The loaded model has exactly one chain whose label chain is A.
setup: Record the scene revision and the chain identities get_inspection_state prints.
Confirm that the intended panel and headset binding are visible.
cases.allowedOutcome: The one chain that letter can mean is hidden, the saved scene carries the label chain and copy id pair, and the spoken line names the chain that went. A model that holds the same label chain more than once refuses instead, in a sentence naming those copies, and a letter the model does not have is refused with the chains it does.
forbiddenOutcomes: A schema path, type name or validation code reaches the wearer or the agent transcript.
One copy of an ambiguous label chain is chosen without asking.
A refusal is reported as a hidden chain, or a hide is acknowledged before it rendered.

cases.title: Ask for the surface by the word the menu row uses
preconditions: The intended scene is loaded in the named Quest session and is drawn as a cartoon.
The spatial menu shows its representation rows, one of which reads Surface.
setup: Record the scene revision and the representation get_inspection_state prints.
Confirm that the intended panel and headset binding are visible.
cases.allowedOutcome: The structure is redrawn as the molecular surface, the receipt says rendered before anything is acknowledged, and the spoken line uses the wearer's own word. The same holds for sticks, ball and stick, ribbon, spheres and spacefill. A word that names none of the four looks is refused in one sentence naming the four.
forbiddenOutcomes: A schema path, type name or validation code reaches the wearer or the agent transcript.
A representation the wearer did not ask for is drawn because their word was unrecognised.
A refusal is reported as a redraw, or a redraw is acknowledged before it rendered.

cases.title: Go to a numbered residue that the recognizer heard as a resident
preconditions: The intended scene is loaded in the named Quest session and has an author residue 141.
The residue browser is open on a page that is not the one holding residue 141.
setup: Record the residue rows the browser is drawing before the utterance.
Record the raw transcript and every normalization rule the Mac proposes for it.
cases.allowedOutcome: Residue 141 is framed and the browser draws it. A recognizer that writes resident for residue is corrected against this scene's own residue numbers and the correction is recorded as rule heard-resident beside the raw text, which is never replaced.
forbiddenOutcomes: A residue the wearer did not name is framed because the noun was misheard.
The correction is applied without being recorded, or the raw transcript is overwritten by it.
A jump is acknowledged before the browser or the molecule drew it.

cases.title: Ask the loop for a structure at an insecure address
preconditions: The intended scene is loaded in the named Quest session.
The wearer is speaking to a conversational loop rather than pressing a menu row.
setup: Record the headset log cursor before the utterance.
Confirm that the intended panel and headset binding are visible.
cases.utterance: Load the structure from http colon slash slash example dot org slash model dot pdb.
cases.allowedOutcome: The request is refused by name, the wearer sees the refusal drawn where they are, and read_headset_log carries one refused outcome record naming the tool and the limit. A refusal raised before the request could become a tool call is reported the same way as one raised inside it.
forbiddenOutcomes: The refusal reaches only the agent terminal and nothing is drawn or recorded for the wearer.
The address, or any credential inside it, reaches the headset log.
The source is loaded, or a load is acknowledged.
